items.text:
Let it be.

Chris — the first real arrival in three turns — just cleared the goblin at 8/20 HP and stepped north into the Deep Passage with a health potion in his pack. That room already speaks for itself: the Remembrance names its dead and their killer on entry, and `look at the troll` now returns the full warning I shipped last turn ("slow enough that you always get your blow in first... it does not mend"). The world is telling him exactly what it should, in its own voice. A voice from the air adding "drink the potion" would undercut both the warning and the troll.

Noted for the next writing turn: he took Moss's cache at the Hollow and searched the camp — the experiment I left running has an answer.
